description: This file defines the GatewayEventHandler class responsible for managing wake words synchronization with a gateway service in an Android application. It handles applying, scheduling, refreshing, and handling voice wake events, utilizing coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Handles synchronization and processing of wake words with a gateway service, utilizing coroutines for asynchronous tasks and JSON parsing for payload handling.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Updates the wake words in preferences and temporarily suppresses further sync to avoid redundant requests.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync of wake words to the gateway if not suppressed and if the device is connected.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Requests current wake words from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON payload indicating wake word changes and applies updates accordingly.
